raw.details:
Baloon National Hackathon is an opportunity for students to showcase their problem-solving, innovation, technical skills, and ability to develop practical solutions to real-world problems. Participants will progress through multiple evaluation stages, with shortlisted teams presenting their solutions to the evaluation panel.

Round 1: Registration & Submission

Step 1: Registration

  • Participants must provide accurate team details, including team name, members, college, specialization, and contact information.

Step 2: PPT & Prototype Submission

  • Registered teams will receive 5–6 days to prepare and submit their solutions.
  • Each team must submit:
    1. Own Problem Statement & Solution PPT: Problem identification, proposed solution, target users, implementation strategy, feasibility, and expected impact.
    2. Prototype: A functional demo, MVP, working model, or interactive prototype demonstrating the proposed solution.
  • Submissions must follow the prescribed format and deadline.

Step 3: Shortlisting

  • All submissions will be evaluated by the screening panel.
  • Teams will be assessed on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical implementation, user impact, and presentation quality.
  • Only shortlisted teams will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: 24-Hour Development Challenge & Evaluation

Step 1: Challenge Brief

  • Shortlisted teams will receive a specific development brief or additional requirements for their selected problem statement.
  • Teams will be given 24 hours to work on the challenge and prepare their updated solution.

Step 2: Solution Development

  • Teams must use the allotted time to implement the required improvements, demonstrate their development process, and prepare their final prototype.
  • The final submission should clearly demonstrate the solution, its key features, implementation, and practical application.

Step 3: Evaluation Schedule

  • After the 24-hour development window, the organising team will share individual evaluation slots with each shortlisted team.
  • Each team will receive a 30-minute evaluation session via Google Meet.
  • The session will include:
    • 15 minutes: Solution demonstration and presentation.
    • 10 minutes: Technical questions and evaluation by the panel.
    • 5 minutes: Feedback and concluding discussion.
  • Evaluation sessions will be streamed or premiered on Baloon's official YouTube channel, subject to the final event schedule and participant communication.

Evaluation Criteria

Teams will be judged on:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Problem-solving approach
  • Technical implementation and functionality
  • Practical feasibility and scalability
  • User experience and potential impact
  • Clarity of presentation and responses to the evaluation panel

General Rules & Guidelines

  • Participants must provide accurate registration and team information.
  • Teams must adhere to all submission deadlines and instructions shared by the organising team.
  • The PPT and prototype must correspond to the registered problem statement.
  • Teams must be able to explain their solution, demonstrate its functionality, and answer questions about their implementation.
  • All team members should contribute meaningfully and be familiar with the submitted solution.
  • Teams must ensure that their prototype and presentation are accessible during evaluation.
  • The organising team reserves the right to shortlist participants based on the evaluation criteria and to communicate any additional instructions when required.

Important: Registration does not guarantee selection for Round 2. Qualification will be based on the Round 1 screening process.
